Hi Martin,
This is your final reminder. Starting Sunday November 1, EU customs will block any product shipped without three required product identifiers.
If you are receiving this email, you still have products with missing identifiers.

We are hosting open office hours to answer questions and provide support at 9am PT, on Friday, October 30th. Join us tomorrow using the link here.<····>
Any EU order containing a product with missing identifiers will not clear customs.
Under the FlavorCloud Terms And Conditions<····>, costs caused by incomplete or incorrect shipment information are the merchant’s responsibility. For shipments placed on or after November 1, we will bill these costs back to your account automatically.
Complete your top-selling EU products now using our setup guide<····>.
If you’re stuck, contact (email hidden)<mailto:(email hidden)> today so we can help before the deadline.
The F. Team
[····]

Note to the team: No reply sent. This is the fourth FlavorCloud compliance blast in the same series (October 13, 20, 27, now the final reminder), addressed to Martin, not a customer message, so there is nothing technical for me to answer.
